name: How do I choose the right roofing contractor for my replacement project?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right roofing contractor for my replacement project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right roofing contractor involves looking for experience, proper licensing, insurance, and positive customer reviews. Obtain multiple estimates and compare them thoroughly. Ensure the contractor provides a clear contract detailing the scope of work, materials, timeline, and warranty. A contractor familiar with local building codes, especially in our service areas like Allen or McKinney, is also important.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for experience, licensing, insurance, and good reviews. Compare multiple estimates, and ensure a clear contract with details on work, materials, and warranty. Check for local code familiarity.
